title: Fibre products, equalizers and final objects in the big and small pro-etale sites agree with those of schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the big pro-etale site, the site of schemes over S, the small pro-etale site of S and the site of affine schemes over S have fibre products agreeing with those of schemes, that the first three have equalizers agreeing with those of schemes, and identifies the final objects (statement lines 2549-2564). The proof (proof lines 2566-2604) checks the closure properties for fibre products, exhibits the equalizer as an explicit fibre product over a diagonal, and verifies stability under weak etaleness and affineness. H2: several verifications with two inputs, written out in full.
